description: Find CVEs by keyword or package name in CISA KEV and OSV (not all of NVD), with KEV status and CVSS v3 where an OSV advisory has one.

ecosystem.description: With package only: npm, PyPI, Maven, Go, crates.io, NuGet, RubyGems or Packagist (or the purl type); default all

kev.description: true: only CVEs in CISA KEV; false: only CVEs not in KEV

limit.description: Most results to return (default 20, at most 50)

package.description: Package name (send q or package, not both), matched exactly in the OSV advisories, e.g. lodash

q.description: Keyword search (send q or package, not both): 1 to 8 words, all must appear in the CISA KEV vendor, product or vulnerability name; also tried as an exact OSV package name

severity.description: Only CVEs of this severity or higher (from the OSV advisories; keeps only CVEs with an OSV score or label, so most KEV-only CVEs are left out)

name: stackfacts_cve_search
